title: Xunfei Xinghuo X2.5 Launch: MoE Architecture Provides Significant Enhancement, Code Writing and Intelligent Agent Capabilities Achieve Leapfrog Upgrades

content_html:
Recently, iFLYTEK officially released the new Xinghuo X2.5 large model. As another important milestone in iFLYTEK's technological advancement, this model has achieved comprehensive upgrades and breakthroughs in architecture design, core capabilities, and domestic computing power compatibility.

In terms of underlying technical architecture and parameter scale, Xinghuo X2.5 adopts an advanced MoE (Mixture of Experts) architecture, with a parameter scale of 293B-A30B. Leveraging this architectural advantage, the model has made in-depth improvements and specialized enhancements in code writing and intelligent agent (Agent) application development capabilities, while continuously strengthening its core capabilities in mathematical logic and comprehensive semantic understanding.

Notably, Xinghuo X2.5 has achieved full self-controlled computing infrastructure. It has completed all processes from end-to-end training to inference based on China's domestic computing power platform, and has continuously overcome and optimized technical challenges related to long sequences in training and inference. Currently, the model is officially launched on iFLYTEK's open platform, offering full access to developers and enterprise users.

In addition to the main model with a large scale, iFLYTEK also opened source two lightweight edge-side models: Xinghuo X2.5-4B and 1.7B. These edge-side models not only support ultra-long context processing up to 1 million Tokens, but can also be deployed locally, perfectly matching diverse application scenarios such as deep processing of long documents, code assistance development, and complex data analysis.
